note: What a real broker is expected to reject in a corpus file that is otherwise fine, so scripts/zeebe-broker-check.mjs reports it as `info` instead of failing the nightly. A corpus file is classified when EVERY error of its rejection belongs to a class that applies to the broker version: `supportedSince` (rejected by older brokers only) or `always` (rejected by every broker; a single-file deployment cannot satisfy it). Any other rejection stays a `fail`, so new corpus files using a feature an older Zeebe lacks need no edit here, and a real regression is still caught. Versions are major.minor.
